title: Juicy Drop
game_overview: A cozy physics puzzle game where players drop and merge fruits inside a wooden jar to evolve giant watermelons.
winning_condition: Merge two giant watermelons to achieve the ultimate celebratory explosion and maximum high score.
losing_condition: Fruits remain stacked above the upper danger line continuously for 2.5 seconds.

controls.action: Position the held fruit horizontally along the top drop line.
Release and drop the active fruit into the container.
Toggle audio synthesis sound effects on or off.
Restart the game session and clear the container.

sections.title: Fruit Evolution Hierarchy
sections.content:
Tier 1: Cherry (r=16, #E63946, 2 pts)
Tier 2: Strawberry (r=24, #FF595E, 4 pts)
Tier 3: Grape (r=32, #8338EC, 8 pts)
Tier 4: Dekopon (r=38, #FB8500, 16 pts)
Tier 5: Persimmon (r=46, #F77F00, 32 pts)
Tier 6: Cucumber (r=52, #38B000, 48 pts, striped & bumpy skin, low friction)
Tier 7: Apple (r=58, #D62828, 64 pts)
Tier 8: Pear (r=68, #A7C957, 128 pts)
Tier 9: Peach (r=78, #FF99C8, 256 pts)
Tier 10: Pineapple (r=90, #FFBE0B, 512 pts)
Tier 11: Melon (r=104, #52B788, 1024 pts)
Tier 12: Watermelon (r=118, #2D6A4F, 2048 pts)
Tier 13: King Durian (r=130, #9EF01A, 5000 pts, spiky golden ring, high density; two King Durians merge into legendary celestial fireworks for 10000 pts).
sections.summary: 13-tier radii, scoring, and color breakdown with Cucumber and King Durian.

sections.title: Power-Up Systems
sections.content: 1. Zero-G Anti-Gravity: Spawns safety ceiling at y=95, inverts gravity to float fruits upwards and shake mid-air, spawns purple/cyan ambient particles, allows clicking fruit to impulse towards twin, and safely settles with grace timer. 2. Magnet Beam: Targets the highest tier matching fruit pair and pulls them together across 90 frames with a glowing electric beam.
